auditRequired.title: Web/PWA file upload → finalize → report → package → Public Verify
auditRequired.note: Independent node:crypto recompute of the downloaded package 14/14 (ZIP digest, Ed25519 seal + key fingerprint, checksum index, report digest, fingerprint, evidence signature, original vs SIGNED digest, custody chain replay, 2 negative controls). J01 22/22 checks: server-hashed SIGNED record, report+package READY from the real worker, share link minted through TOTP step-up, token hashed at rest, revoke/rotate/guess all 404, audit trail complete (admin_audit_logs).

auditRequired.note: Channel does not exist: 0 getDisplayMedia call sites in apps/web.

auditRequired.title: Evidence Request submission → outputs
auditRequired.note: Evidence Requests deliver through intake links (no separate byte path); the request send/delivery step needs the communications provider, which is disabled on the disposable stack. The byte path is R03.

auditRequired.title: Browser extension capture → outputs
auditRequired.note: Extension capture cannot be completed by a user or by the shipped acceptance spec. (1) Shipped harness: AUTH fails INVALID_CLIENT_OR_REDIRECT in both projects (UC-TQ-007). (2) With the operator allow-list supplied after the fixture scan, AUTH passes but the first spec test hung until its 11.2-min backstop without reaching CAPTURE; the run was stopped. (3) Step probe on the same stack: real OAuth/PKCE token OK, service worker registers, but the real popup lists only No workspace available with both Capture buttons disabled (UC-EXT-001); PRESERVE from the extension page without a user gesture is refused (activeTab not granted); the spec capture path (service worker messaging itself) fails Receiving end does not exist (UC-TQ-008). Gesture-driven capture in real Chrome/Edge is therefore unproven (EP-04/EP-05/EP-13).

auditRequired.title: Trash / restore
auditRequired.note: Soft trash keeps the row (deleted_at set), hides it from the library, restore brings it back live; viewer cannot trash.

Integration-level: evidence-destruction-storage, legal-hold-destruction-serialization, defects-destruction-refusals (real PG).
